segments.name: Traditional Banking
segments.description: Provides traditional banking products and services to customers in the Company's market footprint under the traditional RB&T brand.
segments.evidence: The Traditional Banking segment provides traditional banking products and services primarily to customers in the Company's market footprint, with all products and services generally offered under the Company's traditional RB&T brand.

segments.name: Warehouse Lending
segments.description: Provides short-term, revolving credit facilities to mortgage bankers across the U.S., secured by single-family, first-lien residential real estate loans.
segments.evidence: The Core Bank provides short-term, revolving credit facilities to mortgage bankers across the U.S. through mortgage warehouse lines of credit.

segments.name: TRS
segments.description: Tax Refund Solutions: refund transfer products and related tax services for tax providers and their customers.
segments.evidence: Republic's internal information is primarily reported and evaluated in five reportable segments: (I) Traditional Banking, (II) Warehouse Lending, (III) TRS, (IV) RPS, and (V) RCS.

segments.name: RPS
segments.description: Republic Payment Solutions: payment program services and deposits sourced through partner marketer-servicers.
segments.evidence: RPS' largest segment marketer-servicer's ability to meet minimum contractual average deposit thresholds to earn revenue share payments.

segments.name: RCS
segments.description: Republic Credit Solutions: LOC I and LOC II credit products within the RPG operations.
segments.evidence: Republic's internal information is primarily reported and evaluated in five reportable segments: (I) Traditional Banking, (II) Warehouse Lending, (III) TRS, (IV) RPS, and (V) RCS.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay interest and fees on loans and deposits, while tax and payment program partners pay refund transfer and program fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Traditional Banking results of operations are primarily dependent upon net interest income, which represents the difference between the interest income and fees on interest-earning assets and the interest expense on interest-bearing liabilities used to fund those assets.

changes.text: In 2023 the Company dissolved its former insurance captive subsidiary, Republic Insurance Services, Inc.
changes.evidence: The Company dissolved Republic Insurance Services, Inc., its former insurance captive subsidiary, in 2023.
